Game Overview

In Onion, the core idea is straightforward: munch your way through layers of onions in this quirky, fast-paced game. Each click or tap peels away layers, testing your speed and precision. Onion offers a unique and addictively fun challenge with escalating difficulty that keeps every player engaged. Can you master the art of onion-eating?
